last_verification: Phase 1 collection completed successfully. Pooled 2,088 raw items and merged 77 duplicates into 1,000 active queue entries. Route checks, schema validation, and queue normalization all pass with 0 errors.
decisions_made: Initialize harness around existing script workspace
Treat source registry as the source-of-truth for live source lanes
Use reddit-mcp-buddy as the Reddit probe, RSS as the practical fallback, and legacy JSON scraper as preservation fallback
Treat finance and macro intelligence as Lane F, scoped to AI market signals rather than generic financial news
Treat startup fundraising and product discovery as Lane G, separate from broad finance so Series A/B/C and product launches stay visible
Use yt-transcript latest rather than YouTube RSS for creator recency because RSS can lag or miss the true newest videos
When a YouTube day window is configured, retrieve every in-window video transcript; use max_scan_per_channel only as a safety guard
Treat Andrej Karpathy as the single highest-priority YouTube source regardless of video length, with Lex Fridman and TBPN Live above normal P0, and JayE-RoboNuggets as P0 workflow orchestration
Treat XCLI watchlist timeline collection as the reliable X route for now; the algorithmic home-feed route can fail with Page.goto net::ERR_ABORTED
Treat regional coverage as a layered source strategy: RSS for regional media, Reddit for community context, Hugging Face/GitHub for model artifacts, and startup feeds for funding/product signals
Route canonical and compatibility queue persistence through scripts/intelligence_queue.py so protected state uses atomic writes and one URL identity policy
Prepare post drafting packets only for VERIFIED or LIKELY_TRUE items and keep publishing manual-copy only

Route read-only X collection through dedicated home/watch slots and one shared coordinator with notified bounded fallback, fresh-cache policy, rotating JSONL notifications, and PID-aware single-run locking
Compile interactive Sandoz light-themed intelligence dashboard directly embedding data payloads from news_queue.json and phase1_lane_health.json to prevent local CORS errors
Add Polymarket active market YES odds corroboration to VerificationEngine Check 2 and adjust confidence score calculation logic (+10 points for >70% YES, -15 points for <15% YES)
Add support for `--skip-x` command line flag to bypass Lane A (X / Twitter) collection when executing the Phase 1 collection pipeline
